h1: Drug & Alcohol Rehab Serving San Francisco
bodyHtml:
California Treatment Centers helps people across San Francisco find evidence-based care for drug and alcohol use. Whether you live in the Mission, the Sunset, the Richmond, SoMa, or out toward Bayview-Hunters Point, we can help you understand your options and connect you with the right level of treatment. We serve San Francisco and the surrounding Bay Area through our network of California locations, and we can arrange placement and travel when an out-of-city program is a better clinical fit.

Local Context for San Francisco Residents

San Francisco's substance use landscape is shaped by city realities many residents know firsthand, including widespread fentanyl in the street drug supply and the pressures of one of the highest-cost urban environments in the country. The city and county have invested heavily in harm-reduction and treatment access, but navigating that system can feel overwhelming when you or a loved one is in crisis. Long waitlists, confusing referrals, and uncertainty about cost often stop people before they ever begin. Our role is to make the next step clearer, answer your questions in plain language, and match you with appropriate, licensed care rather than leaving you to sort through it alone.

Levels of Care

Recovery is not one-size-fits-all, and the right starting point depends on your history, your health, and what is happening in your life right now. We help San Francisco residents access a full continuum so treatment can step up or step down as needs change:

Medical Detox

Supervised withdrawal management for alcohol, opioids including fentanyl, benzodiazepines, and other substances, with medical monitoring for safety and comfort.

Residential Treatment

Structured, live-in care that removes daily triggers and offers around-the-clock clinical support during the most fragile early weeks.

PHP & IOP

Partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient programs that deliver focused treatment while you keep ties to home, work, or school in the city.

Outpatient & Sober Living

Flexible outpatient therapy plus structured sober living and sober companionship for added accountability as you rebuild.

What Treatment May Include

  • Individual and group therapy grounded in approaches like CBT and motivational interviewing
  • Medication-assisted treatment where clinically appropriate
  • Co-occurring mental health support for anxiety, depression, and trauma
  • Relapse-prevention planning and aftercare coordination
  • Family education and involvement when helpful

Because effective care addresses the whole person rather than the substance alone, our network programs aim to treat underlying conditions alongside the addiction itself. For many people, medical detox is the safest first step when withdrawal carries health risks, before transitioning into ongoing treatment.

Insurance & Cost

California Treatment Centers is in-network with most major insurers, and we offer free, confidential insurance verification so you can understand your coverage before committing to anything. Many plans cover detox, residential, and outpatient services. Verify your insurance and we will walk you through what your benefits likely include and what to expect.

How to Get Started

Reaching out is simple and confidential. Call 213-321-6518 to speak with someone who can listen, answer questions, and outline realistic next steps for you or a loved one in San Francisco. You can also explore our California locations to see where care is available across the state. If you or someone you love is in immediate danger or experiencing a mental health crisis, call or text 988 right away for free, confidential, 24/7 support.
